text: Do the real framework work to achieve it.
resolution: WORLDWIN built as real framework work (63d269066): multi-window wgpu via extra surfaces on the one device (gpu.createWindowSurface/configureExtraSurface), caller-owned detached render targets (scene3d.DetachedTarget/renderDetached — drawScene is encoder-self-contained so nothing re-plumbed), and framework/gpu/world_window.zig blitting the world RT into its own swapchain, driven from the engine loop. Door __compiled_world_window/_close/_status rides the existing compiled-world ingredient; cart gets POP OUT on /compiled and Compile auto-reloads an open window — paint → Compile → second window live, zero flips. In-window: click captures mouse-look, WASD walks (process-wide key state), Esc releases, RMB aims, events consumed so editor hotkeys never fire. Verified: full ship + ingredient label check green, shot boot PASS, cart bundle green; the one red ship was a manifest race with the user's just-launched dev host (by-design self-destruct). Needs eyes on a display: press POP OUT on /compiled.
